experiment: Two-proportion z-tests between control-node ablation arms at full n=999 scale
note: These arms were run in separate invocations (each single-arm, paced across the daily Groq quota), so the raw per-row predictions needed for a paired McNemar test were not retained across invocations -- only aggregate accuracy/n survived. A two-proportion z-test on the aggregates is a valid, standard significance test, though less statistically powerful than a paired test would have been on the same n. control_node_ablation.py has been fixed to persist per-row predictions going forward so a future rerun can support a proper paired test.
